newsitem.title: UK: European straight-run fuels edge up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: European straight-run fuels edge up in thin trade.

text.p: European straight run fuel oil prices were slightly firmer with crude on Wednesday but the firmer prices kept trade thin.
Traders said good supplies capped gains for Russian E4 material despite what traders said was persistent underlying buying interest.
North Sea low sulphur values edged slightly higher in line with a generally firmer tone across the barrel.
Fob NWE liftings were valued around $1 per tonne firmer at $107.50. Dealers said Russian material continued to appear at Baltic ports.
E4 was valued around 50 cents to $1 per tonne firmer at $96 a tonne.
In the Mediterranean, Russian M-40 was talked steady around two means +$6 a tonne delivered.
